newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Noel '96 net profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Noel '96 net profit rises.

text.p: The net profit of Colombia's Industrias Alimenticias Noel rose to 26.64 billion pesos in 1996 from 20.45 billion the previous year, the company said in an earnings statement.

The giant foodmaker and confectioner gave no other results in its statement. But it said it would propose paying a monthly dividend of 26 pesos per share at a stockholders' meeting on March 18 in Medellin.
The dividend would be paid between April 1997 and March 1998, it said.
It also said it was preparing to issue 748,321 new shares on local equity markets that would benefit from an extraordinary once-off dividend of 60 pesos per share.
